meta.title: IDA MCP bridge
meta.description: Connects the Hex-Rays IDA MCP server in this checkout over stdio and exposes its six tools as mcp__ida__*: open a binary in IDA, run IDAPython to decompile and disassemble, look up the ida-domain API, list or save databases, and release the session's database lease. Opening a new binary creates a .i64 beside it. Requires IDA 9.4+ with a valid license, idalib, and an installed uv/uvx. After a one-time uv tool install it starts offline; otherwise uvx needs network or a warm cache. Headless idalib is the default; the IDA GUI path needs a current ida-nexus plugin installed inside IDA and IDA_NEXUS_IDALIB_ONLY=0 in the dsh environment. IDA auto-analysis and Python execution can take minutes, so a tool call may wait up to 7 minutes. Tool schemas join every request while the bundle is enabled. A failed startup leaves the row failed until the environment is fixed and Harness reloads or restarts.
